piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Greetings and polite phrases
texto: Contextual and pragmatic reading: in a real communicative situation, a greeting does not happen in a vacuum. The right response depends on the phrase you receive. If someone greets you with «สวัสดีครับ», the natural expected reply is «สวัสดีค่ะ» or «สวัสดีครับ». If someone lets you go first or helps you, you reply «ขอบคุณค่ะ/ครับ», which is usually followed by «ไม่เป็นไร» (you're welcome / no problem). Contextual reading tests your ability to interpret complete social exchanges.
